To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Indiana Access to Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

I request the following records:

• All forms showing all employees of the Carthage PD who have been "certified" under its 287(g) Memorandum of Agreement with ICE. Please include the name, badge number, and date of certification by ICE. Please include any individuals formerly certified, and the date their certification ended.

• All CPD reports showing all activities engaged in or arrests made by CPD officers engaged in 287(g) activities

If you withhold or redact any information, please provide “a statement of the specific statutory reason for nondisclosure of the information,” as required by the Public Access Counselor’s Handbook.

Invisible Institute is an award-winning nonprofit public accountability journalism organization based in Chicago. Our mission is to enhance the capacity of citizens to hold public institutions accountable. Because I, the requestor, am a journalist, and I seek the information in order to disseminate it to the public, and because the information regards the safety, welfare, and legal rights of the general public, I request a fee waiver for this data. It is not for commercial benefit because I am a member of the nonprofit news media whose principal purpose is to access and disseminate information regarding the general public’s safety, welfare, and legal rights. To the extent you intend to assess any charges, please notify me to discuss first.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 7 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Sam Stecklow

title: Itemized Fee Petitions, Invoices, and Settlement Payouts (Auburn/McMinimee Law)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. All itemized invoices, line-item billing sheets, and fee petitions submitted to Auburn School District, its legal affairs department, its board of directors, or its risk-management carriers by Shannon McMinimee or any agent operating under the domain or entity name "McMinimee Law".
2. All transactional records, ledger entries, checks, voucher approvals, board warrant registry items, or electronic funds transfer records documenting attorney fee payouts, cost reimbursements, or financial settlement distributions paid directly to McMinimee Law or Shannon McMinimee.
3. This request specifically targets but is not limited to all itemized fee breakdowns, billing blocks, and backup ledger documentation associated with any and all OSPI/OAH special education due process dockets where McMinimee Law served as counsel of record.
4. The chronological scope of this request spans from January 4, 2022, through June 30, 2025, specifically targeting all billing blocks, settlement agreements, and fee recovery actions generated while the attorney was concurrently operating under private credentials and public employment contracts.

PRE-EMPTIVE STATUTORY ENFORCEMENT & COMPLIANCE CLAUSE:
The District is advised that, per Washington law (Progressive Animal Welfare Soc. v. University of Wash.), attorney billing records for public payment are subject to disclosure. Only specific, narrow redactions (e.g., student names under FERPA) are permitted, as blanket privilege claims are invalid under Soter v. Cowles Publishing Co.

MANDATORY STATUTORY COMPLIANCE TIMELINE:
A response is expected within five business days as per RCW 42.56.520. The records, requested for non-commercial purposes, should be provided electronically.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Public Interest Mainstreaming Parenting
